_about: Lane B of the krew parity build (2026-10-10): the T0 report day's reader and its two review units. The rest of the window (window/scripts, window/lib, units/) is already placed by the main manifest's `window` and `units` globs.

t0-review.about: crew/scripts/t0-report-hits.py: one T0 rule's report-only hits since a day (and Crissa's hermes safe-root refusals), for the owner's enforce decision; read-only. Its units review the unit-control and Crissa kit rules on a weekly Persistent timer, the day from KREW_T0_REVIEW_SINCE (the reference install fired each once, the day after arming).
